title: OpenCV 4.13 Camera Calibration
summary: Known target object coordinates and corresponding image detections support intrinsic/distortion calibration; tutorial recommends at least ten pattern views. Calibration does not set the scale of an unrelated monocular reconstruction.

title: OpenCV 4.13 Perspective-n-Point pose computation
summary: solvePnP estimates object/world-to-camera rotation and translation from 3D/2D correspondences, intrinsics and distortion; camera axes are X right, Y down, Z forward.

title: Open3D 0.20 ICP registration
summary: registration_icp refines a source-to-target transform from an initial transform and distance threshold; RegistrationResult reports fitness and inlier RMSE. Point-to-plane ICP requires useful normals.

title: Open3D 0.20 global registration
summary: FPFH/RANSAC provides feature-based coarse registration and a transform for subsequent ICP; thresholds and feature scale use cloud units.

title: Open3D 0.20 point-cloud operations
summary: Point-cloud API includes plane segmentation, clustering, normal estimation and returned inlier indices. Fits are sampled geometry evidence.

title: Open3D 0.20 RGB-D integration
summary: Integrates calibrated RGB-D frames and camera poses into TSDF; voxel length controls discretization; marching cubes extracts mesh.

title: Open3D RGB-D odometry
summary: Estimates frame-to-frame motion from RGB-D frames; metric depth and calibration remain sensor-provided evidence.

title: OpenMVG documentation: OpenMVS stages
summary: OpenMVS imports an OpenMVG scene and runs DensifyPointCloud, ReconstructMesh and TextureMesh as separate command-line stages.

title: COLMAP command-line interface
summary: COLMAP documents command-line reconstruction; reused as the SfM/camera and MVS alternative in these recipes.

title: Nerfstudio Splatfacto
summary: Documents Splatfacto training, Gaussian PLY output and memory variants; FAQ states mesh/point-cloud export is unsupported.

title: Nerfstudio geometry export
summary: Documents point-cloud and TSDF/Poisson geometry export; Splatfacto availability conflicts with its specific FAQ and must be checked by exact version.

title: Nerfstudio custom dataset
summary: Documents image/video and pose ingestion paths for scene training.

title: Depth Anything 3 repository
summary: Existing report records multi-view depth, poses and point/Gaussian exports; model outputs remain estimated geometry and scale claims need controls.

title: Depth Anything 3 streaming README
summary: Existing report records long-sequence streaming and a below-12-GB GPU memory claim; reused from reconstruction.md.

title: CloudCompare command-line mode
summary: Command line opens, processes and saves cloud/mesh data; exact commands depend on the selected operation and version.

title: TripoSR repository
summary: Existing report records single-image textured mesh output and approximately 6 GB VRAM claim; backside and dimensions are learned estimates.

title: TripoSR model card
summary: Existing report records MIT terms for code/checkpoint; reused from reconstruction.md.

title: Microsoft TRELLIS.2 repository
summary: Existing report records single-image mesh/GLB generation and Linux/NVIDIA >=24 GB memory requirement for TRELLIS.2-4B.

title: Microsoft TRELLIS.2-4B model card
summary: Existing report records MIT terms for source and model card; reused from reconstruction.md.

title: SAM 3D Objects repository
summary: Existing report records >=32 GB NVIDIA GPU guidance and custom SAM terms for local code/checkpoints.

title: OCS Engineering skill instructions
summary: Local skill defines explicit units, origins, axes, datums, part boundaries, constrained model edits, readback and measured checks; retain it for remodeling handoff.

title: OpenMVS usage and COLMAP importer
summary: Documents COLMAP image_undistorter output as the input to InterfaceCOLMAP, then DensifyPointCloud and later mesh stages; OpenMVG is an alternate importer.

title: COLMAP FAQ: known camera intrinsics
summary: Documents ImageReader camera parameters, shared camera setup, pycolmap database read/update API, default bundle-adjustment intrinsic refinement, and the +0.5 pixel-center correction from OpenCV/Kalibr.

title: COLMAP camera models
summary: Documents COLMAP corner-based pixel coordinates, camera conventions and model selection; OPENCV and FULL_OPENCV distortion model details.

title: COLMAP command-line interface
summary: Documents feature_extractor options including ImageReader camera model/parameters, mapper and image_undistorter command routes.

title: Meshroom command-line batch usage
summary: Official Meshroom instructions document `meshroom_batch --input INPUT_IMAGES_FOLDER --output OUTPUT_FOLDER`; the executable also accepts a saved pipeline graph.

title: Nerfstudio custom image/video dataset
summary: Documents `ns-process-data images|video --data ... --output-dir ...` and `ns-train nerfacto --data ...`; image/video processing uses COLMAP and FFmpeg.

title: Nerfstudio installation and CLI examples
summary: Official install guide documents CLI environment and a video-processing command; used only for documented CLI context, no installation was run.

title: TripoSR inference README
summary: Official README command is `python run.py <image> --output-dir <dir>`; it states about 6 GB VRAM per single image and MIT terms for code and pretrained models.
